verdict.rationale: Algolia documents exporting analytics metrics as CSV/XLSX files. Its Search API and CLI can manage indices, records, settings, rules and synonyms, which implies programmatic retrieval of index contents. Because Algolia searches only a copy of data you send it, the source of truth stays with you, but no evidence shows a documented bulk export of all records and configuration in an open format. Missing for 10: an explicit documented full-data export (records, settings, rules, synonyms) in open formats, offboarding/portability guidance, and independent confirmation that a complete export works.
